sections.title: Constraint (choose one)
sections.description: Which quantity is fixed (D, rh or Veff); the other two are computed from it and are read-only.
Radio buttons: Fix D, Fix rh or Fix Veff.

sections.title: Diffusion / volume
sections.description: Diffusion time, diffusion coefficient, hydrodynamic radius, structure parameter S = wz/wxy and effective volume, tied by the Stokes-Einstein relation at temperature T and viscosity η.

sections.label: τ (µs)
sections.description: Diffusion correlation time τ_D.

sections.label: D (µm²/s)
sections.description: Translational diffusion coefficient (read-only unless 'Fix D').

sections.label: rₕ (nm)
sections.description: Hydrodynamic radius (read-only unless 'Fix rₕ').

sections.label: S (wz/wxy)
sections.description: Confocal aspect ratio (axial / lateral beam waist).

sections.label: Veff (fL)
sections.description: Effective confocal volume (read-only unless 'Fix Veff').

sections.label: T (°C)
sections.description: Temperature.

sections.label: η (mPa·s)
sections.description: Solvent viscosity; computed from the water model when 'Use water η(T)' is enabled.

sections.label: Use water η(T)
sections.description: Use the temperature-dependent viscosity of water (Kapusta 2010 app note).

sections.title: Occupancy
sections.description: Mean number of molecules N in the effective volume (G(0) = 1/N) and the corresponding concentration in nM.

sections.label: 1/N
sections.description: Inverse occupancy G(0) = 1/N; exceeds 1 for sub-single-molecule occupancy.

sections.label: N
sections.description: Average number of molecules in Veff.

sections.label: Conc (nM)
sections.description: Concentration; N = 0.602214 × c_nM × Veff_fL.

sections.title: Reference dye (D @ 25 °C, water)
sections.description: Reference dye with a known diffusion coefficient at 25 °C in water; its D is rescaled to the current temperature and viscosity.
Choose the reference dye whose known diffusion coefficient sets the calibration.

sections.title: Molecular shape
sections.description: Estimates D of a sphere, ellipsoid or cylinder from its size (nm) and aspect ratio.
Shape type, size (nm) and aspect ratio; apply writes the resulting D into the calculator.

sections.title: Settings JSON
sections.description: Current calculator settings as JSON; copy it out or paste one in to restore them.
Editable JSON text of all calculator settings.
